master.promptText:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: TWO separate NEW full-body Halloween character illustrations for a casual mobile board-game shop, one transparent sprite master sheet. Newly drawn original characters; not a screenshot or traced source.
Composition: landscape1536x1024 with exactly TWO columns and ONE row. LEFT cell contains one friendly Dracula showman. RIGHT cell contains one friendly mummy. Entire body of each character including head, hands and feet is complete. Each stays in its own768x1024 cell, with at least80px genuine transparent empty gutter between figures and margins around the canvas. No objects connect the two figures. No grid. Each figure occupies most of the cell height, with a compact upright readable silhouette.
LEFT character: a charming theatrical Dracula SHOWMAN, friendly playful adult male vampire cartoon. Oversized pale warm ivory face, slick black hair with pronounced widow's peak and slightly pointed tufts at the sides, dark expressive eyebrows, smiling warm eyes, a wide cheerful smile with just TWO tiny neat white vampire fangs. Short slim stylized body wearing a tailored black tuxedo-like suit and short black boots, warm dark-red waistcoat, a little red neck bow, and a black cape with vivid red inner lining sweeping gently behind his body. One open hand raised as if presenting a magic show, the other hand opened outward in welcome. Confident jaunty pose, full body. NO props or objects in the hands, no product, no cane.
RIGHT character: a cute friendly MUMMY, oversized round-oval head and short chubby cartoon body wrapped fully in soft ivory and warm beige cloth bandages from head to rounded feet. Layered curved bandage strips, a small loose bandage tail at one side. An open charcoal-black shadowed face window reveals TWO glowing warm golden-yellow friendly oval eyes and a big sweet happy open smile. Round harmless proportions, no wounds or realistic corpse details. Arms lightly extended out to the sides as if happily welcoming the viewer, slightly leaning jaunty pose. Full body, no props.
Style/medium: polished soft3D cartoon casual-game character art, smooth sculpted forms with gentle fabric shading and readable bright colors, warm expressive faces and toy-like proportions. Cohesive visual style across both. Strong clean silhouettes that remain readable small.
Background: genuine alpha transparency outside the exact character silhouettes and inside open gaps around arms/legs/capes. All four canvas corners and all inter-character space are truly transparent. No backdrop color, no painted checkerboard, no stage, no scenery, no floor, no ground plane or cast/drop shadow.
Text: NONE.
Hard constraints: characters ONLY. Exactly two characters in stated order. No UI, no screenshots, no panel, no frame, no card, no button, no price, no currency, no dice, no cash, no foil packs, no products or reward bundles, no count, no timer, no star, no badge, no logo, no letters, no numbers, no watermark. No extra people, no bats, no candles, no Halloween decorations or floating particles. No surrounding shadows. Dracula and mummy are new illustrations from a generic friendly Halloween concept, not copies of an existing branded mascot.

scope: Only new shop-art authoring/production/import-staging assets and this manifest. No source/design/UI/guide/STATUS/report/server/7007 or existing assets changed.
